scope: AI Settings now exposes a user-triggered action to invoke the existing profile-scoped bounded job-scoring consumer after preview.
The API response includes job title and company so advisory structured evaluations can be reviewed in context.
Evaluation results are held in the active browser view, remain advisory, and do not change deterministic match scores or create documents.
Changing profiles, previewing again, or changing/saving the policy clears the displayed evaluation results.
